entities.summary: The Yusef Abad Synagogue, officially Sukkat Shalom Synagogue, is an Orthodox Jewish congregation and synagogue, located at the junction of 15th Street and Sayyed Jamáleddin e Asadábádi Ave, in the Yusef Abad neighborhood of Tehran, in Iran.
